name: When should I get a water intrusion assessment for my roof?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a water intrusion assessment for my roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a water intrusion assessment if you notice signs of water damage inside your property, such as stains on ceilings or walls, peeling paint, or a musty odor, even if you can't see an obvious leak. It's also recommended after severe weather events or if you suspect previous repairs didn't fully resolve a leak. Early detection is key to preventing minor issues from escalating into expensive structural repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get an assessment when you see signs of water damage, after severe weather, or if past repairs were ineffective, to prevent further damage.
